title: Decision: Appointment of the Next Director-General
text:
CS-2025-5384(E) distributed 27/11/2025 
*CS-2025-5384.E* 
 
 
OPCW 
Conference of the States Parties 
Thirtieth Session 
24 – 28 November 2025 
C-30/DEC.7 
27 November 2025 
Original: ENGLISH 
DECISION 
APPOINTMENT OF THE NEXT DIRECTOR-GENERAL 
The Conference of the States Parties, 
 
Recalling that, in accordance with subparagraph 21(d) and paragraph 43 of Article VIII of the 
Chemical Weapons Convention, and Rule 82 of the Rules of Procedure of the Conference of 
the States Parties (the Conference), the Director-General of the Technical Secretariat of the 
Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons shall be appointed by the Conference 
upon the recommendation of the Executive Council (the Council) for a term of four years, 
renewable for one further term, but not thereafter; and 
 
Noting the recommendation of the Council at its 110th Session to the Conference at the present 
session on the appointment of the next Director-General (EC-110/DEC.4, dated 10 October 2025); 
 
Hereby: 
 
1. 
Appoints Ms Sabrina Dallafior Matter as the Director-General of the Technical 
Secretariat of the Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons, for a term of 
office beginning on 25 July 2026 and ending on 24 July 2030; and 
2. 
Authorises the Chairperson of the Conference to conclude a contract with the next 
Director-General on the terms and conditions set out in the decision of the Conference 
at its First Special Session (C-SS-1/DEC.4, dated 25 July 2002), as periodically 
adjusted by the Council in conformity with the provisions of the last operative 
paragraph of that decision.
